rightsPolicy.referenceOnly: Do not archive or reuse whole third-party source footage. Keep URL/videoId/channel/title/thumbnail/transcript/timecodes/style observations only.
rightsPolicy.ownedLicensedAuthorized: Local download, screen recording or mirror may be used when actually required by the production runtime.
rightsPolicy.identity: Do not clone source creator/traveler identity or voice. Final production must use owned/licensed talent or a non-identical generated persona.
rightsPolicy.policyClaims: Creator statements about copyright or platform policy are observations only until verified against official sources.

templates.cameraRule: Medium interview/two-shot, reaction closeups, screen zoom/cursor, proof screen immediately after a claim.
templates.motionRule: Use owned/generated screen demonstrations and UI mockups; alternate interview, proof, reaction and timeline detail.
templates.transitionRule: Hard/reaction/screen-insert cuts; refresh visual evidence every 5-15 seconds where semantically justified.
templates.audioRule: Natural host/expert dialogue; demo playback only where useful; restrained stingers; no source-voice cloning.
templates.subtitleRule: Dialogue, translated-source reference and narrator tracks must be visually distinguishable.

templates.microExperienceRule: Ordinary local detail → foreign-traveler reaction → concise explanation → next curiosity beat.
templates.cameraRule: Traveler/reaction reference rhythm, transport/place detail, wide establishing shot and map/fact card; final footage must be owned/licensed or non-identical generated scenes.
templates.motionRule: Alternate narrator setup, traveler reaction, contextual B-roll and route/location cards; preserve LIVE ROAD continuity.
templates.transitionRule: Cliffhanger/reveal cuts; introduce an honest negative before the final verdict; bridge every destination to the next route stop.
templates.audioRule: Narrator + owned/licensed traveler dialogue; location ambience; no source-voice cloning.
templates.subtitleRule: Traveler translation, narrator and fact/context captions must be visually separate.
templates.factRule: All numeric, ranking, operating-status, fare, transport and official-system claims require current verification before final render/publish.
templates.liveRoadRule: Every experience block should resolve to PLACE/FOOD/TRANSPORT/WHY_FOREIGNERS_GO/APP_CTA fields when applicable.
